subject: DI05000171

body.en:
Definition

An inverter converts a DC source into an alternating output by a controlled switching sequence; output frequency and waveform are set by control and topology.

Classification / scope

  • Source: VSI/CSI; phase: single/three; bridge: half/full; control: square, quasi-square, PWM.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • A voltage-source inverter has a stiff DC voltage link, usually with a DCcapacitor; it must never short that link through one bridge leg. Current-source inverter constraints differ.
  • Single/three phase, half/full bridge, square/PWM, and voltage/current source are independent categories; output filtering and the load determine current quality.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Inverter controlled switchingથી DCને alternating outputમાં ફેરવે; frequency/waveform control/topology નક્કી કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Source: VSI/CSI; phase: single/three; bridge: half/full; control: square/quasi-square/PWM.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • VSI stiff DC link/capacitor ધરાવે; legથી link short નથવો જોઈએ; CSI constraints જુદાં.
  • Single/three phase, half/full bridge, square/PWM, VSI/CSI અલગ axes; filter/loadથી current quality નક્કી થાય.

title.en: 4.2 HF, THD, DF and LOH: definitions with conventions
title.gu: 4.2 HF, THD, DF તથા LOH: Convention સાથે વ્યાખ્યા

h.en: HF, THD, DF and LOH: definitions with conventions
h.gu: HF, THD, DF તથા LOH: Convention સાથે વ્યાખ્યા

body.en:
Definition

Waveform quality measures quantify harmonic components relative to a declared fundamental and measurement bandwidth; their definitions must be stated before comparing values.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Harmonic factor HFn=Vn, rms/V1, rms; THD=√Σn>1Vn, rms²/V1, rms. LOH is the lowest nonzero harmonic order above1, not the switching frequency by definition.
  • In classical inverter/filter texts, DF=(1/V1)√Σn>1(Vn/n²)² is a frequency-weighted distortion factor. Other texts call V1/Vrms a distortion factor; these are different definitions, so declare which is used.
  • For ideal bipolar square output±Vdc, only odd harmonics appear, V1, rms=2√2Vdc/π, total Vrms=Vdc and voltage THD≈48.34%.RL current THD is not automatically48.34%.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For odd n, the square-wave Fourier peak is Vn, pk=4Vdc/(nπ); even terms vanish by half-wave symmetry.
  2. THD=√[(Vrms/V1, rms)²−1]=√(π²/8−1)≈0.4834; LOH=3and HF3=1/3.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Waveform quality measures declared fundamental/bandwidth સામે harmonics માપે; comparison પહેલાં definition જરૂરી છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • HFn=Vn, rms/V1, rms; THD=√Σn>1Vn, rms²/V1, rms; LOH order1પછી lowest nonzero harmonic છે, switching frequencyની definition નહીં.
  • Classical inverter/filter DF=(1/V1)√Σn>1(Vn/n²)²; બીજા textમાં V1/Vrmsને distortion factor કહે છે; બંને જુદાં હોવાથી convention લખો.
  • Ideal ±Vdc squareમાં odd harmonics, V1=2√2Vdc/π, totalV=Vdc/THD≈48.34%; RL currentTHD automatic48.34%નથી.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Odd n માટે Vn, pk=4Vdc/(nπ); half-wave symmetryથી even terms zero.
  2. THD=√[(Vrms/V1, rms)²−1]=√(π²/8−1)≈0.4834; LOH3/HF3=1/3.

title.en: 4.3 Single-phase half bridge VSI: R and RL
title.gu: 4.3 Single-phase Half Bridge VSI: R તથા RL

h.en: Single-phase half bridge VSI: R and RL
h.gu: Single-phase Half Bridge VSI: R તથા RL

body.en:
Definition

A half bridge uses two controlled switches and a split DCbus to alternate the load terminal between positive and negative half-bus voltages relative to the midpoint.

Construction / circuit connections

  1. Two series switches form one leg across the DCbus; split capacitors form midpoint O; load connects leg node A to O; each switch has a reverse-current path.

Working / conduction intervals

  1. Top switch commands+Vdc/2, bottom commands−Vdc/2 with nonoverlap; never command both ON.
  2. During RLpolarity reversal, current initially keeps its sign through a diode before crossing zero; the DC source/link must handle returned energy.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Vdc here means total rail-to-rail DC voltage, so output levels are±Vdc/2.Capacitor midpoint balance and dead time are essential.
  • For R, current follows voltage. For RL, current lags and the appropriate antiparallel diode conducts when its sign is opposite the commanded voltage.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For square switching, total Vrms=Vdc/2; fundamental V1, rms=√2Vdc/π.
  2. At Vdc=24V, R=12Ω: output±12V, Irms=1A, P=12W, V1, rms≈10.80V.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Half bridge બે switches/split DC busથી midpoint સામે loadને positive/negative half-bus voltage આપે છે.

Construction / સર્કિટનાં જોડાણ

  1. DC across two series switches/split capacitors midpoint O/load A–O/reverse-current diode paths.

Working / Conductionનો ક્રમ

  1. Top+Vdc/2/bottom−Vdc/2, nonoverlap; બંને ON નહીં.
  2. RL reversalમાં I sign પહેલા diodeથી ચાલુ/પછી zero; DC link returned energy handle કરે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Vdc total rail-to-rail છે, output±Vdc/2; midpoint balance/dead time જરૂરી.
  • Rમાં I followsV; RLમાં lag/voltage સામે I sign હોય ત્યારે diode path મળે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Squareમાં totalVrms=Vdc/2; V1, rms=√2Vdc/π.
  2. Vdc24V/R12Ωમાં±12V/Irms1A/P12W/V1≈10.80V.

h.en: Single-phase full bridge VSI: R and RL
h.gu: Single-phase Full Bridge VSI: R તથા RL

body.en:
Definition

A full bridge uses two switching legs to impose a positive, negative or zero differential voltage across a load without requiring a split-bus midpoint.

Construction / circuit connections

  1. Four switches with antiparallel diode paths form two legs across Vdc; load is between leg nodes Aand B.
  2. DCdecoupling, precharge if required, current sensing, driver interlock and appropriate snubber/layout complete practical design.

Working / conduction intervals

  1. Alternate diagonal pairs for square output±Vdc; insert a designed nonoverlap transition.
  2. For RL, trace current sign independently of switch command; voltage can reverse while current remains in its old direction.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Label AupperQ1, AlowerQ2, BupperQ3, BlowerQ4.Positive output usesQ1+Q4; negative usesQ2+Q3; zero states use both uppers or both lowers with safe commutation.
  • R current=vo/R; RL current is continuous within ideal inductance and can flow through reverse diodes during regeneration/freewheel. Dead time prevents shoot-through but introduces waveform error.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Square total Vrms=Vdc; V1, rms=2√2Vdc/π.At24V, R=12Ω, Irms=2A, P=48W, V1, rms≈21.61V.
  2. For sinusoidal fundamental on RL, Z1=√(R²+(ωL)²), I1=V1/Z1 with lag atan(ωL/R); this is not total RMSwhen harmonics remain.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Full bridge બે legsથી split midpoint વિના load across positive, negative/zero differential V આપે છે.

Construction / સર્કિટનાં જોડાણ

  1. Four switches/diodes બે legs બનાવે; load A–Bવચ્ચે.
  2. DC decoupling, required precharge, current sensing/interlock/snubber-layout practical design પૂરું કરે.

Working / Conductionનો ક્રમ

  1. Diagonal pairs alternateથી±Vdc; designed nonoverlap ઉમેરો.
  2. RLમાં I sign commandથી અલગ trace; Vreverse છતાં Iજૂની directionમાં રહે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Labels: AupperQ1/AlowerQ2/BupperQ3/BlowerQ4; positiveQ1+Q4/negativeQ2+Q3; zero બંને upper/lower, safe commutation સાથે.
  • R I=vo/R; RLમાં continuity/reverse diodesથી energy paths; dead time short અટકાવે પણ waveform error આપે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Square totalV=Vdc/V1=2√2Vdc/π; 24V/R12Ωમાં Irms2A/P48W/V1≈21.61V.
  2. RL fundamentalમાં Z1=√(R²+(ωL)²), I1=V1/Z1/lag atan(ωL/R); harmonics હોય તો totalRMS નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Pulse-width control changes the conducting duration of inverter output pulses to regulate its RMS/fundamental voltage and redistribute harmonics.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Single-pulse control uses one centred pulse per half-cycle; multiple-pulse control uses several pulses per half-cycle. Their fundamental and total RMSmust not be treated as equal.
  • With a pulse beginningδand endingπ−δin the positive half, and negative symmetry, the pulse widthγ=π−2δ.
  • Multiple pulses shift significant harmonics toward pulse repetition bands but require more switching events and loss; not every increase in pulse count improves every harmonic.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For the centred single-pulse waveform, total Vrms=Vdc√(γ/π).
  2. Fourier integration gives V1, pk=(4Vdc/π)cosδ=(4Vdc/π)sin(γ/2); V1, rms=V1, pk/√2.
  3. At Vdc=24V, γ=120°, δ=30°: Vrms≈19.60V, V1, rms≈18.71V.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Pulse-width control output pulse duration બદલી RMS/fundamental regulate/harmonics redistribute કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Single-pulse દર half એક centred pulse; multiple-pulse ઘણા pulses; fundamental/totalRMS સમાન નહીં.
  • Positive pulse δથીπ−δ/negative symmetryમાં widthγ=π−2δ.
  • Multiple pulses harmonics higher bandsમાં ખસેડે પણ switching/loss વધારે; દરેક harmonic સુધરે એવું નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Centred single-pulseમાં totalVrms=Vdc√(γ/π).
  2. Fourierથી V1, pk=(4Vdc/π)cosδ=(4Vdc/π)sin(γ/2); V1, rms=V1, pk/√2.
  3. 24V/γ120°/δ30°માં Vrms≈19.60V/V1≈18.71V.

h.en: Sinusoidal PWM: reference, carrier and linear range
h.gu: Sinusoidal PWM: Reference, Carrier તથા Linear Range

body.en:
Definition

SPWMcompares a sinusoidal reference with a high-frequency carrier to determine switching instants whose averaged fundamental follows the reference.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Amplitude ratio ma=Vref, pk/Vcarrier, pk; frequency ratio mf=fc/f1.In the linear region0≤ma≤1, fundamental output is approximately proportional to ma.
  • Overmodulation clips reference comparison and changes harmonics/linearity; sampling, dead time, DCripple and filter design affect actual output.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For ideal full-bridge bipolar SPWM linear operation, V1, pk≈maVdc; V1, rms≈maVdc/√2.
  2. For half bridge with total DCbus Vdc, V1, rms≈maVdc/(2√2).
  3. With24Vbus, ma=0.8, fc=2kHz, f1=50Hz: mf=40and full-bridge fundamental≈13.58Vrms, not total unfiltered PWM RMS.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

SPWM sinusoidal referenceને high-frequency carrier સાથે compare કરીને switching instants નક્કી કરે છે જેથી averaged fundamental reference અનુસરે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • ma=Vref, pk/Vcarrier, pk/mf=fc/f1; linear0≤ma≤1માં fundamental ma પ્રમાણે.
  • Overmodulation clipping/harmonics-linearity બદલે; sampling, dead time, DCripple/filter actual output બદલે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Ideal full-bridge bipolar SPWM linearમાં V1, pk≈maVdc/V1, rms≈maVdc/√2.
  2. Half bridge totalVdcમાં V1, rms≈maVdc/(2√2).
  3. 24V/ma0.8/fc2kHz/f1 50Hzમાં mf40/full-bridge fundamental≈13.58Vrms, total PWM RMS નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Bipolar PWM switches the bridge differential output between+Vdc and−Vdc; unipolar PWMcommands its legs with opposite references to obtain+Vdc, zero and−Vdc levels.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • In bipolar PWM, the diagonal pair changes together under safe dead time. In unipolar, leg Acompares+sinand leg Bcompares−sinto the same carrier.
  • Both give the same ideal linear fundamental maVdc peak for full bridge, but differential ripple spectra differ; unipolar often reduces low-band ripple and shifts prominent output ripple toward2fc.
  • Zero differential output does not mean both leg nodes are at earth potential. Common-mode voltage, device transitions and EMIstill matter.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Bipolar differential output+Vdc/−Vdc વચ્ચે; unipolar opposite referencesથી+Vdc, zero/−Vdc આપે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Bipolarમાં diagonals safe dead timeથી બદલાય; unipolarમાં A+sin/B−sin same carrier સામે.
  • બંનેનો ideal fundamental peak maVdc; differential ripple જુદી/unipolar prominent ripple ઘણીવાર2fcતરફ.
  • Zero differential એટલે earth potential નહીં; common-mode/transitions/EMI મહત્વનાં.

body.en:
Definition

A three-phase VSI uses three bridge legs to produce three phase-displaced pole voltages from a DCbus; load phase voltage depends on the load neutral connection.

Construction / circuit connections

  1. Six switches with reverse diodes, three gate-driver pairs, DCdecoupling, current protection and A/B/Cload terminals.

Working / conduction intervals

  1. Apply the six-state sequence with proper dead time; use neutral displacement to calculate star phase voltage.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Use a consistent convention: AupperQ1/AlowerQ4, BupperQ3/BlowerQ6, CupperQ5/ClowerQ2.Each upper has a complementary lower; never mix this numbering with the single-phase bridge labels.
  • In180°mode each device is commanded for180°and three devices conduct ideally, one per leg, with states changing every60°.
  • One upper-state sequence abc is100, 110, 010, 011, 001, 101.For an isolated star neutral, van=Vdc[Sa−(Sa+Sb+Sc)/3]and vab=Vdc(Sa−Sb).
  • Phase steps are±Vdc/3or±2Vdc/3and line steps are0, ±Vdc; the pole-to-negative-rail voltage is not the load phase voltage.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Ideal six-step180°fundamental line RMS=√6Vdc/π≈0.7797Vdc; total line RMS=√(2/3)Vdc.
  2. At Vdc=24V: fundamental line≈18.71Vrms, total line≈19.60Vrms.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Three-phase VSI ત્રણ legsથી phase-displaced pole voltages બનાવે; phase voltage load-neutral connection પર આધારિત છે.

Construction / સર્કિટનાં જોડાણ

  1. Six switches/diodes, three driver pairs, DCdecoupling/current protection/A-B-Cload.

Working / Conductionનો ક્રમ

  1. Six-state/dead time લાગુ કરી neutral displacementથી phaseV ગણો.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Convention: AupperQ1/AlowerQ4, BupperQ3/BlowerQ6, CupperQ5/ClowerQ2; single-phase labels સાથે mix નહીં.
  • 180°modeમાં દરેક device180°/એક પ્રતિ leg ત્રણ devices/દર60°state બદલાય.
  • Upper state sequence100, 110, 010, 011, 001, 101; isolated starમાં van=Vdc[Sa−(Sa+Sb+Sc)/3]/vab=Vdc(Sa−Sb).
  • Phase steps±Vdc/3/±2Vdc/3, line0/±Vdc; pole-negative rail load phase નથી.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Ideal six-step180°fundamental lineRMS=√6Vdc/π≈0.7797Vdc; total lineRMS=√(2/3)Vdc.
  2. Vdc24Vમાં fundamental line≈18.71Vrms/total line≈19.60Vrms.

body.en:
Definition

In120°conduction control, each device has a120°command interval and one upper plus one lower device connect two phases at each60°sector; the third phase is not actively connected.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • With the declared numbering, use pairsQ1Q6, Q1Q2, Q3Q2, Q3Q4, Q5Q4, Q5Q6for successive60°sectors.
  • For a balanced isolated-star Rload, the two conducting phase voltages are±Vdc/2and the floating phase is0relative to the instantaneous neutral.
  • With RL load, the nominally uncommanded phase can carry diode current; do not apply the R-load floating-phase values blindly. For both modes, command timing and actual current conduction are different concepts.
  • Compared with180°, 120°has60°uncommanded interval per device and two commanded devices rather than three; waveforms and utilisation differ.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

120°modeમાં દરેક device120°command/દર60°એક upper-lowerથી બે phases જોડાય, ત્રીજી actively disconnected છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Declared numberingમાં successive60°pairs Q1Q6, Q1Q2, Q3Q2, Q3Q4, Q5Q4, Q5Q6.
  • Balanced isolated-star Rમાં connected phases±Vdc/2/floating0relative neutral.
  • RLમાં uncommanded phase diode current લઈ શકે; R floating values blindly નહીં.Command/current conduction જુદાં.
  • 180°ની સામે120°માં device દીઠ60°uncommanded/two devices; waveform/utilisation જુદાં.

body.en:
Definition

A source-suggested learning plan, not a claim that fabrication, testing or a visit has occurred.

Working / conduction intervals

  1. Write objective, ratings, assumptions, roles, resources and approved safe work boundary before starting.
  2. Choose an isolated low-energy bridge, consistent gate labels, nonoverlap and current protection; Rload first, RL only with approved energy paths.
  3. Check expected results independently and obtain instructor approval before any permitted low-energy demonstration.
  4. Submit gate/output traces, total versus fundamental RMS and diode-current explanation; do not connect to utility wiring.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Choose an isolated low-energy bridge, consistent gate labels, nonoverlap and current protection; Rload first, RL only with approved energy paths.
  • Submit gate/output traces, total versus fundamental RMS and diode-current explanation; do not connect to utility wiring.

Reliability and precautions

  • Keep actual date, measurements, teacher sign and portfolio evidence blank until genuine; no exposed mains, battery abuse or unqualified high-energy switching.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Source-suggested learning plan છે, fabrication/test/visit થઈ ગયાનો claim નહીં.

Working / Conductionનો ક્રમ

  1. પહેલાં objective, ratings, assumptions, roles, resources/safeboundaryલખો.
  2. Lowenergybridge/labels/nonoverlap/currentprotection; Rપહેલાં/RLapprovedpathsથી.
  3. Expectedresultsindependentlycheck/lowenergydemoપહેલાં approval.
  4. Gate/output, total/fundamental/diodeexplanation; utilitywireનહીં.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Lowenergybridge/labels/nonoverlap/currentprotection; Rપહેલાં/RLapprovedpathsથી.
  • Gate/output, total/fundamental/diodeexplanation; utilitywireનહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A source-listed performance guide; actual execution, date, readings and signatures are not claimed.

Construction / circuit connections

  1. Isolated≤24VDClimited bridge board, nonoverlap drivers, R/RLdummy load, DSO/differential probe and current sensor.

• Full square: Vrms=Vdc, V1=2√2Vdc/π; half values are half for equal total bus.
  • SPWMfull linear V1≈maVdc/√2; fundamental RMS≠total PWM RMS.

Python standard library only. Save as models.py.No equipment I/O,SPICE session,official VLab or physical test is claimed.

"""Offline ideal teaching models. No device I/O, SPICE claim, hardware or real battery control."""
import math

def dc_design(kind,vin,vo,io,fs,di,dv):
    if min(vin,io,fs,di,dv)<=0:raise ValueError('Positive Vin,Io,fs,ΔI,ΔV required')
    v=abs(vo)
    if kind=='buck':
        if not 0<vo<vin:raise ValueError('Buck requires 0<Vo<Vin')
        d=vo/vin;l=(vin-vo)*d/(fs*di);c=di/(8*fs*dv);i=io;block=vin
    elif kind=='boost':
        if vo<=vin:raise ValueError('Boost requires Vo>Vin')
        d=1-vin/vo;l=vin*d/(fs*di);c=io*d/(fs*dv);i=io/(1-d);block=vo
    elif kind=='inverting':
        if vo>=0:raise ValueError('Inverting output must be negative')
        d=v/(vin+v);l=vin*d/(fs*di);c=io*d/(fs*dv);i=io/(1-d);block=vin+v
    else:raise ValueError('Unknown topology')
    return dict(duty=d,L_H=l,C_F=c,Iavg_A=i,Imin_A=i-di/2,Ipeak_A=i+di/2,blocking_V=block,CCM=i>di/2,assumptions='Ideal CCM,small ripple,zero ESR;not a BOM or stability validation')

def controlled_average(vrms,alpha_deg,mode='R',active_dc_source=False):
    if vrms<=0 or not 0<=alpha_deg<=180:raise ValueError('Invalid voltage/angle')
    if mode not in ('R','RL_CCM_NO_FWD','RL_CCM_FWD'):raise ValueError('Unknown load/current model')
    a=math.radians(alpha_deg);vm=math.sqrt(2)*vrms
    if mode=='RL_CCM_NO_FWD':
        if alpha_deg>90 and not active_dc_source:raise ValueError('Passive RL cannot sustain assumed inversion/positive CCM')
        return 2*vm*math.cos(a)/math.pi
    return vm*(1+math.cos(a))/math.pi

def rectifier_samples(vll=24,f=50,samples=12000):

    v=abs(vo)
    if kind=='buck':
        if not 0<vo<vin:raise ValueError('Buck requires 0<Vo<Vin')
        d=vo/vin;l=(vin-vo)*d/(fs*di);c=di/(8*fs*dv);i=io;block=vin

        if vo<=vin:raise ValueError('Boost requires Vo>Vin')
        d=1-vin/vo;l=vin*d/(fs*di);c=io*d/(fs*dv);i=io/(1-d);block=vo
    elif kind=='inverting':
        if vo>=0:raise ValueError('Inverting output must be negative')
        d=v/(vin+v);l=vin*d/(fs*di);c=io*d/(fs*dv);i=io/(1-d);block=vin+v
    else:raise ValueError('Unknown topology')
    return dict(duty=d,L_H=l,C_F=c,Iavg_A=i,Imin_A=i-di/2,Ipeak_A=i+di/2,blocking_V=block,CCM=i>di/2,assumptions='Ideal CCM,small ripple,zero ESR;not a BOM or stability validation')
